title: 608 bearing housing
prompt: Housing ring for a 608 bearing (22 mm OD, 7 mm wide): 30 mm outside diameter, 8 mm tall, with a 22 mm pocket 7 mm deep from the top and a 1 mm lip at the bottom that leaves a 19 mm hole.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
Three cylindrical faces: outside, 22 mm pocket and 19 mm lip bore
Three flat faces: bottom, top and the lip the bearing sits on
